newsitem.title: JAPAN: Marubeni unit to supply programmes to broadcasters.
newsitem.headline: Marubeni unit to supply programmes to broadcasters.

text.p: Japanese trading company Marubeni Corp said on Monday it has set up a company to supply programmes to digital satellite broadcasters and cable television companies.
The new company, Media Cubic Programming, is capitalised at 100 million yen.
Marubeni said in a statement that it would recruit new shareholders and the company's capitalisation would eventually be raised to 20 billion yen.
Marubeni recently announced that it would take a minor stake in the digital satellite broadcasting venture, Japan Sky Broadcasting Co.
The new company aims to produce and supply programming content, data information and videogame software for digital satellite broadcasters, CATV operators and the Internet, Marubeni said.
The new company aims for annual sales of 50 billion yen five years from now, Marubeni said.
